items.title: Derrick Gardner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 9, 2013
items.q: "tunes like a tune by Miles Davis and Wayne Shorter... or other Wayne Shorter stuff like 'El Gaucho' by Herbie Hancock"

ctx.x: I saw a quote from your website that had to do with introducing new music to the jazz genre. Do you feel that’s part of your goal, your mission?

Oh without a doubt. Without a doubt you know. You can only play “All the Things You Are” but so many times you know, along with all the other great standards that have been put out there. And there are even a lot of tunes by — preexisting tunes that haven’t been played a lot, tunes like a tune by Miles Davis and Wayne Shorter, who wrote “ESP” on that Miles Davis record; or other Wayne Shorter stuff like “El Gaucho” by Herbie Hancock or Gigi Gryce or anybody you know. But nonetheless, we have something to say,…
I want to see if this will work for me. I want to ask you about something here.
